import type { PgliteDatabase } from 'drizzle-orm/pglite';
import * as schema from './schema';
import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { drizzle } from 'drizzle-orm/node-postgres';

export type DB=PgliteDatabase<typeof schema>;
const e=process.env;
if(e.CI!=='true'||e.GITHUB_ACTIONS!=='true'||e.RUNNER_OS!=='Linux'||
 e.ALT0810C29_EPHEMERAL!=='1'||e.PGHOST!=='127.0.0.1'||
 e.PGPORT!=='5432'||e.PGDATABASE!=='vigia_alt081_ci'||
 e.PGUSER!=='vigia_ci'||e.PGPASSWORD!=='isolated_ci_only'||
 e.DATABASE_URL||e.RLS_DATABASE_URL||
 e.ALT0810C29_SCHEMA!=='alt0810c29_real_route')
 throw Error('ALT0810C29_DISPOSABLE_ONLY');
const pool=new Pool({host:'127.0.0.1',port:5432,
 database:'vigia_alt081_ci',user:'vigia_alt0810c29_route',password:'ci29_route_only',
 options:'-c search_path=alt0810c29_real_route'});
const db=drizzle(pool,{schema}) as unknown as DB;
export async function getDb():Promise<DB>{return db}
